decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority (4189-01, unnumbered existing ground floor plan and site location plan and technical information received 23/06/2011, 4189-02B and Noise report received 28/09/2011), or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The air conditioning condensers shall not be operational outside of the hours of 0900 - 1800 Monday to Friday unless otherwise agreed beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The acoustic enclosures shown on drawing 4189-02B shall be installed prior to the units becoming operational and shall be presently retained and kept in working order unless otherwise agreed beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Installation of 2 air conditioning condensers to rear of the building
